references.text: The first census of the tribe of Gad, which counted 45,650 men, provides a basis for comparison with this second count showing 40,500 men.
The preceding verses list the specific clans of Gad's sons that are summarized in this verse.
Genesis mentions the sons of Gad who went to Egypt, who are the ancestors of the clans counted here.
The tribe of Gad and their position in the camp are described here, along with their leader and the number from the first census.
